audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Ornn Levels 2, 3 and 2+ items while whys[1] says Yone edges level 2, whys[2]/[3] call levels 3 and 4-5 even, and whys[6] says Yone reclaims the late duel.
audit.why: 49.21% Ornn win rate over 3526 games — this is a slightly losing lane, and the packet chart matches the prose on every disputed row while the stored chart matched none.
audit.corrected: Rows 1,2,3,4,6 realigned to Yone, Skill, Skill, Ornn, Yone in both layers with ratings to match.

audit.why: Four spikes: Yone early, Ornn at 3, Ornn at 6, Yone at 2+ items — consistent with the corrected chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Yone ability was named — 'his Q3', 'W cleave', 'E spirit-rewind' throughout — and no cooldowns appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Mortal Steel (Q) is 4s and the cast at two stacks dashes him forward with a knock-up — it carries the dash flag, so Volcanic Rupture's grounding shuts it off. Spirit Cleave (W) is 14s and shields him, scaling with attack speed. Soul Unbound (E) is 22/19/16/13/10s and leaves his body behind, replaying a portion of the damage when it ends. Fate Sealed (R) is 120/100/80s and blinks behind the last champion in the line.
audit.corrected: Named all five, added cooldowns, and stated the grounding denial of the third Mortal Steel.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown breakdown had no numbers and described Soul Unbound vaguely.
audit.why: Soul Unbound at 22s rank 1 is the window; the body stays in place while the spirit roams, which is where Ornn's pillar should go.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns and the dos/don'ts around real values.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — He snaps back when it ends. Brittle in it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Soul Unbound (E): 22s at rank 1 — he snaps back to his body when it ends, so fight the return, not the exit. - Mortal Steel (Q): 4s, and the third cast dashes and knocks up. - Spirit Cleave (W): 14s shield.

edits.before: Track Yone's Soul Unbound: He snaps back when it ends. Brittle in it. When it is down — W-E + R him.
edits.after: Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 — his body stays put, so Q the pillar on the body and meet the rewind.

edits.before: He snaps back when it ends. Brittle in it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 — his body is the real target, so wait there.

edits.before: Yone wastes Soul Unbound — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Soul Unbound spent — 22 seconds without a reset, so commit now.

edits.before: That is Yone's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Mortal Steel's third cast dashes and knocks up — your Q grounding denies it.

edits.before: Still shieldless and mana-starved, you eat his Q-poke trades; he edges the level-2 window before your W.
edits.after: Mortal Steel is a 4s poke and Spirit Cleave shields him every 14s — he edges level 2 before your W.

notes: Whether Soul Unbound's rewind can be denied is not answerable from the kit text, so the advice was framed as positioning on the body rather than claiming an interrupt. As with the other Ornn matchups, existing 'unstoppable W with a shield' phrasing is unsupported by Riot's description and was left untouched.
